name: 英国议会 · 真人跟读

sentences.en: That day has come for me. This is the end of my political journey.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，那一天已经到来。这是我政治生涯的终点。

recordings.label: 真人原声
recordings.text: That day has come for me. This is the end of my political journey.

sentences.en: And in two years in government, I leave the country in better shape than I found it.
sentences.zh: 执政两年后，我离任时这个国家比我接手时状况更好。

recordings.label: 真人原声
recordings.text: And in two years in government, I leave the country in better shape than I found it.

sentences.en: I am proud of everything that we have achieved.
sentences.zh: 我为我们取得的一切成就感到自豪。

recordings.label: 真人原声
recordings.text: I am proud of everything that we have achieved.

sentences.en: I am proud of all we have achieved together, and proud of each and every one of you.
sentences.zh: 我为我们共同取得的一切成就，也为你们每一个人感到自豪。

recordings.label: 真人原声
recordings.text: I am proud of all we have achieved together, and proud of each and every one of you.

sentences.en: To all colleagues across the House, can I wish you good health and happiness.
sentences.zh: 祝议会各方的所有同僚身体健康、生活幸福。

recordings.label: 真人原声
recordings.text: To all colleagues across the House, can I wish you good health and happiness.

sentences.en: To my wife and children, I love you.
sentences.zh: 致我的妻子和孩子：我爱你们。

recordings.label: 真人原声
recordings.text: To my wife and children, I love you.
